proof_body:
by
  intro f x y d h
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (s + y * Complex.I)) d x :=
    (h.comp_add_const (x : ℂ) (y * Complex.I)).comp_ofReal
  have hin : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (x : ℂ) + w * Complex.I) Complex.I (y : ℂ) := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (y : ℂ)).mul_const Complex.I).const_add (x : ℂ)
  have h2' : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => f ((x : ℂ) + w * Complex.I)) (d * Complex.I) (y : ℂ) :=
    HasDerivAt.comp (y : ℂ) h hin
  have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t * Complex.I)) (d * Complex.I) y := h2'.comp_ofReal
  have a1 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x h1
  have a2 := Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y h2
  have a3 := Complex.reCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y h2
  have a4 := Complex.imCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x h1
  have e1 : (d * Complex.I).im = d.re := by simp
  have e2 : (d * Complex.I).re = -d.im := by simp
  refine ⟨a1, ?_, ?_, a4⟩
  · rw [← e1]
    exact a2
  · rw [← e2]
    exact a3
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (x y : ℝ) (d : ℂ), HasDerivAt f d (x + y * Complex.I) → HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (f (s + y * Complex.I)).re) d.re x ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (f (x + t * Complex.I)).im) d.re y ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (f (x + t * Complex.I)).re) (-d.im) y ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (f (s + y * Complex.I)).im) d.im x
